claims: Calibration can improve confidence accuracy in Qwen3.5-9B and GPT-OSS-120B on out-of-distribution domains in SafePyramid (in-distribution dataset) and DynaBench (out-of-distribution dataset), and on in-distribution domains in SafePyramid (in-distribution dataset).
Evidence rewards can improve rule support on out-of-distribution domains in SafePyramid (in-distribution dataset) in Qwen3.5-9B and GPT-OSS-120B.
Binary correctness rewards can improve F1 over Jaccard on out-of-distribution domains in DynaBench (out-of-distribution dataset), with thinking off, in Qwen3.5-9B and GPT-OSS-120B.
structure: Main findings and ablation findings within each claim. Fixed-policy experiment nested under calibration. No next steps.
